content.comment_body: Hello, I'm interested in using the [product_name] display panel to input a set point for PI regulation. Any suggestions? Currently, I've used an analog input paired with a variable resistor, but this seems inefficient and uses unnecessary inputs.
Hi, you can link the PI set point to a message text and then modify it during operation. Please check the attached example.

Hi, set the parameter you want to change as a message text. If the message text isn't protected, you can adjust its value while the message is active on the display. For instructions on changing a parameter via message text, refer to [document], specifically page 241 of the current [product_name] manual.
Thank you for the helpful responses. It appears to be achievable. I appreciate your assistance!

analysis.insight_summary: Participants talked about utilizing the display panel of the [product_name] for direct input of set points in PI regulation. Initially, an analog input with a variable resistor was used, but it was considered inefficient. Other users noted that values can be edited through unprotected text messages shown on the display and referenced the relevant [product_name] manual for further details.
analysis.user_expectations: The user wishes to conveniently modify the set point for PI regulation directly on the [product_name] display, aiming to reduce hardware usage and streamline the overall process.
